name: math-ponytail
description: Reduce low-value definitions and notation in mathematical writing while preserving meaning, scope, and legitimate redefinitions.

interface.longDescription: Makes mathematical text easier to read by inlining low-value aliases while preserving first definitions, notation, reminders, local scope, and legitimate redefinitions.
defaultPrompt: Simplify the notation in this proof without changing its meaning.
Find and remove unnecessary definitions in this mathematical text.
Write this proof using only notation that earns its mental cost.
